QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_20

question.text: SEBI defines a 'Hedge Fund' as an AIF which:

answer.text: Employs diverse or complex trading strategies and invests/trades in securities with diverse risks or complex products

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 19 and 33 of the source carry the SEBI definition of a hedge fund: an AIF that employs diverse or complex trading strategies and invests or trades in securities with diverse risks or complex products, including listed and unlisted derivatives. The Trap: Narrow asset-class definitions (only real estate, only bonds, only IPOs) do not capture the SEBI emphasis on strategy diversity and product complexity. Note: The phrase "listed and unlisted derivatives" is part of the SEBI wording and should be preserved when citing the definition.
